skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand organizational change, resistance to change, theories of change management, processes of organizational change management, learning organizations, and organizational development.
Demonstrate effective communication, presentation, negotiation, and time management skills.
Apply analytical skills to assess change drivers and resistors within organizations.
Apply change management processes within organizations.
Understand and apply concepts of organizational learning and development.
Demonstrate professional skills including planning, coordination, evaluation, and improvement of work.
Demonstrate social responsibility and ethical behavior in professional practice.
